items.question: How do I create a free restaurant website?
items.answer: Enter your email on IQ Rest, verify with a code, name your restaurant — done. Your website with QR menu is live in under 5 minutes. No credit card required.

items.question: Do I need any technical skills?
items.answer: No. Everything is designed for restaurant owners, not developers. Add dishes, upload photos, and manage your site entirely from your phone.

items.question: What's included in the free plan?
items.answer: A full restaurant website, QR menu, contact page with map, analytics, custom color scheme, and up to 2 languages. No trial period — it's free forever.

items.question: Can I use my own domain name?
items.answer: On the free and Basic plans, your site is hosted at iq-rest.com/m/your-name. The Pro plan supports custom domain names for full brand control.
